fixedPoint: HEAD b0fae5d7cbd55cb603258d830d9c2900bc351107; shared dirty worktree reviewed only at the laser-fence availability hunk, its focused test, and its untracked evidence files.

findings.evidence: The specification requires an enemy-only beam that damages on crossing, consumes itself and ends the victim turn. The changed hunk only enables the existing placement path; Tick does not evaluate laser-fence links.
findings.recommendation: Add a public-behavior test and runtime link collision resolution before claiming laser_fence complete. Cover damage, one-shot link consumption, active-turn ending and own-team safety.

findings.evidence: The specification also requires persistent linked beams. Nodes exist, but no runtime data records consumed links or exposes a beam state.
findings.recommendation: Model an active link pair with a stable identity so a triggered beam does not re-arm automatically.
